mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 9.0% for two consecutive months signals labor market improvement, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns negative in >60% of UNRATE < 9.0 instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, accelerating corporate revenue growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or signal fails in >60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production growth (INDPRO > 1.5% MoM) combined with low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%) eases supply constraints, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
regime_hint: high industrial growth and low rates
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns negative in >60% of INDPRO growth >1.5% and FEDFUNDS <2.0 instances, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained quarterly real GDP growth above 2.0% (GDPC1) signals strong economic expansion, supporting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns negative in >60% of GDPC1 growth >2.0% instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank tightening expectations that drive negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns positive in >60% of CPIAUCSL YoY >3.0% instances, or Rank IC > -0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent decline in unemployment (UNRATE) and acceleration in payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 when UNRATE declines and PAYEMS grows, or signal fails in >60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%) combined with low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%) constrains central bank policy, maintaining low real rates and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns negative in >60% of CPIAUCSL YoY >3.0% and FEDFUNDS <2.0 instances, or Rank IC < 0.03.
